mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, it drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, signaling a weakening housing market, it drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing slowdown weighs on economic activity.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST decline > 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year, signaling strong consumer spending, it drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the strong spending boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Y/Y RSAFS growth > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, signaling a very tight labor market, it drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the strong labor market boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k jobs/mo for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 200k jobs/mo for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, signaling high inflation, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, signaling accommodative monetary policy, it drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is likely to keep rates low to support growth despite high inflation.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL Y/Y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of triggered instances.
